source.method: Independent PDF vector outlines and glyph centres; single physical scale per board. No raster artwork. Nominal dimensions refer to p7; Armageddon perimeter protrusions are retained.
source.precisionNote: Diagram-derived placement, not surveyed physical terrain. The source board frame differs from 44:60 by up to the recorded frame error. Do not infer sub-millimetre accuracy from displayed decimals.
